scope: Classic hierarchical list discovered automatically in an area-owned form: order, depth, expansion, selection, keyboard-driven selection and disclosure with the list's own events, reveal, VoiceOver navigation and operation

environment.compiler: 4D Server 20.8 Compile project, arm64_macOS_lib and x86_64_generic

pixels: Each AX run compares the form, before any action, with the same window built without plugin, component or helpers: zero changed pixels below the title bar. Under Rosetta, interpreted, AppKit's window-title text differed by one antialiasing level in 430 pixels.

checks: the list is an outline labeled by its help tip
visible items appear in 4D's order, collapsed children omitted
each item reports its depth
expanded and collapsed groups report their state
the list's own selection is reported
the form is pixel-identical to the plugin-free form
selecting Straps in a partly scrolled list is accepted
a partly scrolled list selects exactly the requested item
selecting Stands is accepted through accessibility
the list's own selection and click events run for Stands
the new selection is published
4D runs in the requested interpreted mode
expanding Guitars is accepted through accessibility
the list's own On Expand event runs for Guitars
Guitars' children appear beneath it at the next level
expanding an expanded group is accepted
an expanded group is left alone, without a click or event
expanding the nested Keyboards group is accepted
a nested group's children appear two levels deep
collapsing Guitars is accepted through accessibility
the list's own On Collapse event runs
a collapsed group's children leave the outline
revealing Headphones, below the visible lines, is accepted
the list scrolls Headphones into view
selecting the revealed item is accepted
the click after scrolling selects exactly Headphones
VoiceOver reaches the list by its label
interacting starts on the selected item, with its position and level
a collapsed group is read with its state and disclosure triangle
VO-Space expands the group through the list's own On Expand and announces it
VoiceOver's disclosure command collapses it through On Collapse and announces it
VoiceOver moves to the next item
VO-Space selects the item through the list's own events

rejectedApproach: Pointer clicks at computed item points. After a half-line trackpad scroll, 4D reports the next whole line, and a click selected the item above the requested one. Keyboard selection and disclosure need no geometry.
